people.name: Zechariah
people.line: Priest, father of John the Baptist

translations.web: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
translations.bsb: “How can I be sure of this?” Zechariah asked the angel. “I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.”
translations.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
translations.asv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
